data.one_liner: Select a random element from any iterable, optionally using weights.
data.what_it_does: The package exposes a generic randomChoice<T> function that returns a randomly selected item from an iterable. You can provide a parallel list of numeric weights to bias the selection.
use_when: You need a quick, dependency‑free way to pick a random item from a list or set
You want weighted random selection without pulling in larger libraries
avoid_when: You need asynchronous streams or reactive selection
strengths: Null‑safe and works on all Dart platforms
weaknesses: Uses dart:math random, not suitable for security‑critical use
